title: nutritious Egyptian ground oats Tagine
description: A hearty, earthy, one-pot dish that combines the flavors of Egypt with the nutty goodness of ground oats. This vegetarian-friendly recipe is perfect for a filling meal or snack.

ingredients.name: tempering chocolate
ingredients.notes: available at most middle eastern grocery stores

instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large saucepan over medium heat.
Add the onion, garlic, and ginger and cook until the onion is translucent, about 5 minutes.
Add the cumin, coriander, salt, and black pepper and stir to combine.
Add the ground oats and cook for 1-2 minutes, stirring constantly.
Add the tempering chocolate and stir to combine.
Pour in enough water to cover the oats and bring to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low, cover, and simmer for 20-25 minutes or until the oats have absorbed most of the liquid.
Stir in the chopped parsley and serve hot.
Adjust the seasoning to taste and serve over rice, if desired.
